svg.aria-label: Atlas Coast world layout with organic curved city roads and roadside facilities

g.text: GRAND TOURING OPEN WORLD · ORGANIC CITIES
ROADS: ivory = highways · gray = curving streets · gold = race circuits · ochre = dirt
PINS: cream = dealerships · orange = garages · tan = fuel · yellow = race starts
Roadside buildings are offset and rotated along the true local road tangent
